verification_policy: Every configured price carries provider source, assumed tier, currency, and verification status. Unverified prices are surfaced as dry-run warnings by stage.

exchange_rates.plan_or_tier: ECB euro reference rate on 2026-10-13: 1 EUR = 1.1188 USD; USD→EUR is the reciprocal

cheap.plan_or_tier: Standard paid tier; introductory rate through 2026-12-31

writer.plan_or_tier: Standard paid tier; introductory rate through 2026-12-31

premium.plan_or_tier: Claude API standard token pricing; global routing, no batch/caching modifier

sol.plan_or_tier: APIMaster gateway price list (pricing_version a42d372c...), tier 'standard' for prompts up to 272000 tokens: input 2, output 10 (reasoning tokens are output), cache read 0.1, cache write 2.5 USD per 1M tokens. The gateway reports no cost field for this model, so the ledger prices the reported tokens.

luna.plan_or_tier: APIMaster gateway price list read on 2026-10-18, tier 'standard' for prompts up to 272000 tokens: input 0.2, output 1.2 (reasoning tokens are output), cache read 0.02, cache write 0.25 USD per 1M tokens. The gateway reports no cost field for this model, so the ledger prices the reported tokens.

eleven_v4.plan_or_tier: ElevenAPI pay-as-you-go, Text to Speech Eleven v4; $0.08 per 1,000 characters

brave_web.plan_or_tier: Brave Search prepaid Search plan; $5 per 1,000 requests; monthly free credits excluded

heygen.provider_model: HeyGen avatar video from a photo look (API default engine)
heygen.source_url: wallet balance before and after each call, 2026-10-19 (GET /v3/users/me)
heygen.plan_or_tier: HeyGen API pay-as-you-go, photo look, 1080p mp4; measured: 35.04 s video = USD 1.32, 33.04 s = USD 1.25 (USD 0.0377 per second); creating one photo look = USD 1.32

visual_research.source: measured on case 9 (agent_runs, Visual Verifier, 391 completed checks: 8,290 input and 375 output tokens on average; 54+12 of 388 judged photos passed = 0.17); queries from the research stage of job 20 (56) and the gap search (18)

elevenlabs_sound.provider_model: ElevenLabs sound-generation / Eleven Music API (used by app/documentary/music.py)
elevenlabs_sound.verification_note: Secondary sources (not ElevenLabs official docs) disagree: USD 0.12-0.30 per minute depending on source and whether sound-generation or Eleven Music v1/v2 is meant. assumed_eur_per_minute uses the high bound (EUR 0.27/min) so bookings never under-report; every row is estimated=true with cost_source=assumed-unverified until a real wallet-balance before/after measurement (same method as heygen.eur_per_minute) sets a verified rate.
